name: PayPal

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - communication and reasoning weighed more than raw LeetCode difficulty, since the domain is moving money
rounds: Technical screen (sometimes via Karat, a third-party interviewing service, sometimes directly with a PayPal engineer)
Onsite loop: pair programming, system design, project-experience deep-dive, behavioral, hiring-manager conversation
extraTopics: Explaining assumptions and trade-offs, not just reaching a correct answer - interviewers probe reasoning about systems that move money
SQL alongside DSA in some pipelines

Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy - DSA, system design, and a role-specialization round
extraTopics: Security, scalability and fraud/risk-aware design thinking, given the payments domain
Senior Software Engineer.notes: Loop composition varies by team; senior full-stack loops add extra role-specialization rounds.

ladder.title: Staff Software Engineer, Principal Engineer
ladder.notes: Not covered in depth by the cited sources
